summary: Markets showed resilience Friday as stocks rallied despite ongoing US-Iran tensions in the Strait of Hormuz. The Dow closed up 0.29% after Thursday's sharp chip-led gains, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq extended their advance. Oil prices eased after spiking earlier in the week when President Trump declared the Iran ceasefire 'over,' though geopolitical risk remains elevated. Investors are positioning ahead of next week's critical CPI data (due July 14) and the start of Q2 earnings season, with major banks reporting. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's congressional testimony on July 14 will be closely watched for clues on rate trajectory, as markets price in at least one 25bp hike later in 2026. Bitcoin ETFs snapped a brutal 10-day outflow streak with $221.7 million of inflows, offering a rare bright spot in crypto after the worst month on record for spot BTC products.

signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs post worst month on record with $4.5B June outflows
signals.desc: Spot Bitcoin ETFs hemorrhaged $4.5 billion in June, pushing year-to-date flows negative for the first time, signaling weak institutional demand as Citi slashed its 12-month BTC target from $112K to $82K.

signals.title: Fed Chair Warsh set to testify on July 14 with rate hike risk looming
signals.desc: New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh will testify to Congress alongside June CPI release (consensus ~4.2% YoY), with nine of 18 FOMC officials penciling in at least one 2026 rate hike, pressuring risk assets.

signals.title: US-Iran conflict escalates in Strait of Hormuz, oil volatility spikes
signals.desc: Trump declared Iran ceasefire 'over' after attacks on commercial vessels pushed WTI crude up 4.37% to $73.52; oil has since retreated as talks continue, creating two-way volatility in energy and geopolitics.

signals.title: SK Hynix surges 13% on blockbuster US debut, chip rebound underway
signals.desc: South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix ADRs jumped 13% above IPO price on Friday's trading debut, lifting semiconductor sector as VanEck SMH ETF rose 2.5% Thursday, signaling AI demand resilience.

signals.title: Q2 earnings season kicks off with S&P 500 growth expected at 23.3% YoY
signals.desc: Major banks (JPM, BAC, GS, WFC, C) report July 14, followed by mega-cap tech through month-end; consensus sees energy and tech leading earnings growth, offering potential catalyst for indices nearing record highs.

verdict: Markets face a pivotal week ahead with CPI, Warsh testimony, and earnings convergence likely to determine whether the current rally extends or stalls on renewed inflation and rate-hike concerns.
